note: Base plan of the fixture recorder (scripts/fixtures-record.mjs, `npm run fixtures:record -- --out "$ARTIFACT_DIR/fixtures" --plan`). Entries are requests as the app sends them; "serve" answers a scenario id in place of the real id (source.kind derived); "derive" copies a written fixture and patches it; "hand" entries are written without network. Re-running is idempotent (cached raw answers are re-scrubbed and rewritten).

notes: E8 (similar works): every page scenario answers 200 with a derived list (success shape assumed equal to the search results for works and to the E5 output objects for outputs), because the live recommender upstream answered 404 for every identifier tried (11 probes on 2026-10-20) and a 404 makes the browser log a resource error on every works and outputs page. The real 404 recordings are kept in works-1007 and outputs-2006 (the "unable to process" state, V12).

E9 (doi.org citations): the app sends two requests per DOI that differ only in the Accept header (apa, bibtex). The resolver keys on method, URL and body, so both map to one fixture holding the apa answer; the bibtex answers are kept in the raw recordings only.
E19 formap is a subset (50 of the 15,803 rows); the Jest and parity builds read data/ or the data snapshot, not this answer.

Mutating calls (E10, E16, E17) are hand fixtures with canonical request bodies listed in each file (test data only, no e-mail address: the scrub check rejects the pattern). A test that types other values answers through a handler, rule or its own `kind: "hand"` entry in test/fixtures/requests/<pkg-id>.json.

E21/E22 logos: the live endpoint answers a PNG for a provider id; scenario logos holds the live answer for provider 86 and copies of it for the other member providers that appear on the recorded pages (and the live 404 for .../undefined/logo). Map tiles and core.ac.uk/image PNGs and the empty gtag script come from the resolver rules.

The members fixture at the canonical URL is the one-eligible-member list (provider 86); the full list is served at ?scenario=full for T-113 only. It supersedes the harness calibration fixture hand/harness-t725/c0ed569f870d.json (same key, I-29): the resolver reads api/ first and reports one conflicting-fixtures problem until the harness removes the old file.

No live 410 body was reachable (works 1-8, outputs 1-12, 18 provider ids and three disabled-flag searches all answered 200/404/200-empty): works-4100/4101/4102 and outputs-4100 are derived from the live 404 answer with status 410 and three body types (VF-03).
Provider answers are scrubbed: the `email` contact field is blank; nothing else of a provider object is personal data.
